mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (member_id, type, title, message, target_path) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{message}, #{targetPath})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET read_at = NOW(6) WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND read_at IS NULL
